question: Which of the following is a tertiary consumer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tertiary Consumer**__:-

 __
 
• It is the** top consumer **at the trophic level in an ecosystem.
 
• The tertiary consumers consume the secondary consumers like birds, fish.
 
• These are also called Top Carnivores which includes Man as well.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Producers**-

 
 
• They are at the first in the trophic level.
 
• Example includes **Phytoplankton, grass, and trees**.
 
 
 
• **Primary Consumers**-
 
 
• These are the consumers who depend on the plants.
 
• Example includes **Grasshopper and cow**.
 
 
 
• **Secondary Consumers**-
 
 
• This refers to when animals can eat other animals which in turn can eat the plants (or their produce).
 
• Example includes** Birds, fishes, wolf**.
